company.name: Faction
company.shortDescription: Faction is a software company that develops driverless solutions based on light electric vehicles.
company.description:
Faction develops software and services for driverless electric vehicles.  Faction's supervised autonomous vehicle solutions include remote human TeleAssist® supervision, so we’re not gated by waiting for 100% autonomous technology.

Initially, Faction is focusing on micro delivery for last mile logistics and vehicle-on-demand, where you can summon a vehicle and drive it yourself.  The company has active customer programs in operation on public roads.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States
